English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #fake AI-generated video falsely shared as real footage of the ancient city of Dwaraka False The claim that the video shows the real city of Dwaraka is false; it is an AI-generated creation. by Anonymous | April 29, 2025 FactSeeker observed a video circulating on social media with the caption, “We all see the city of Dwaraka, where Lord Krishna ruled. Despite the passage of time, its beauty remains unchanged.” The video had been widely shared, prompting FactSeeker to investigate. Upon further examination, it was noticed that the video contained a watermark of “@mbaiarts” at the bottom. A search on social media revealed that the video had been posted on the Instagram page “mbaiaret” on April 9, 2025. Additionally, the Instagram post mentioned that the video had been created using Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology. To verify this, FactSeeker conducted an analysis on the Deepware website, confirming that the video had indeed been generated by AI. Therefore, FactSeeker confirms that the video circulating on social media, which shows the submerged city of Dwaraka from the reign of Lord Krishna, is an AI-generated creation.
